The ultimate financial data CLI + MCP server for SEC EDGAR 13F filings, insider trading, and Smart Money convergence signals.
Deterministic SEC filing analytics. Parse, score, and diff 10-K and 10-Q filings. Reproducible JSON scores from text metrics, boolean risk flags, and section diffs.

Live and historical market data for: Stocks, FX, crypto, commodities, indices and ETFs over WebSocket and REST.
This is a database of 300.000+ symbols containing Equities, ETFs, Funds, Indices, Currencies, Cryptocurrencies and Money Markets.

Invert a stock price into the bet it implies: the growth, duration, and margin a price assumes. Textbook expectations-investing reverse DCF over SEC EDGAR filings. No price targets, no ratings.
